query FindManyAgentChatThreads($filter: AgentChatThreadFilterInput, $orderBy: [AgentChatThreadOrderByInput], $lastCursor: String, $limit: Int, $offset: Int) {
  agentChatThreads(
    filter: $filter
    orderBy: $orderBy
    first: $limit
    after: $lastCursor
    offset: $offset
  ) {
    edges {
      node {
        __typename
        assigneeId
        channelArchivedAt
        channelId
        channelSnoozedUntil
        contextWindowTokens
        conversationSize
        conversationType
        createdAt
        deletedAt
        directMessageFirstWorkspaceMemberId
        directMessageSecondWorkspaceMemberId
        id
        lastActivityAt
        lastMessageSenderWorkspaceMemberId
        lastMessageText
        participants {
          edges {
            node {
              __typename
              archivedAt
              id
              isSubscribed
              lastMentionedAt
              lastReadAt
              mentionsResolvedAt
              snoozedUntil
              threadId
              updatedAt
              workspaceMemberId
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        pendingQuestionMessageId
        title
        totalCacheReadTokens
        totalInputCredits
        totalInputTokens
        totalOutputCredits
        totalOutputTokens
        updatedAt
        workspaceMemberId
        writerWorkspaceMemberIds
      }
      cursor
      __typename
    }
    pageInfo {
      hasNextPage
      hasPreviousPage
      startCursor
      endCursor
      __typename
    }
    totalCount
    __typename
  }
}
